generation_invariants: Read GitHub state before generating a batch.
Never infer prior canonical word tuples from memory when an exact GitHub tuple is available.
Preserve explicit target history and avoid duplicate explicit targets unless a documented promotion or distinct chunk applies.
Preserve character identities and storyline max order continuity.
Generate and QA each chapter atomically inside a batch.
A level has five published SQL batch artifacts, each containing eight chapters.
Do not advance production_state until all eight chapters and cross-chapter QA pass.
A failed chapter is retried without advancing batch or series state.
Do not depend on /mnt/data for future B1+ generation.

historical_lineage.note: The connected GitHub writer accepts UTF-8 text files, not this binary ZIP. Exact A1/A2 historical executable SQL remains identified by checksum; future content generation no longer requires that archive because canonical resume state is stored as GitHub text resources.
